name: system-skilled-bots
description: Parent hub for four modes over file-defined headless bots: author writes or edits a BOT.md from the shipped template, run starts a bot, queues or drains run requests and answers a needs-you item (bots answer), schedule installs or removes a cron bot's launchd schedule and enables, disables, pauses or resumes a bot, and status reads installed bots, last runs, deliveries and the needs-you inbox (bots inbox). workflowMode selects the packet through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json. The advisor identity input is graph-metadata.json.
trigger_examples: author a bot that summarizes open pull requests every morning
schedule a bot to run on weekdays at nine
show bot status and the last bot run
what do the bots need from me
